{{Quote|And I doubt even Sauro could muster enough support for a vote of no confidence. Let's see, he controls the Viga alliance, and the planets in the Commerce Guild, and&hellip;yes, he could get several systems in the Mid-Rim.|[[Tyro Caladian]]|<ref name="JQ" />}}
The '''Viga alliance''' was a [[Politics/Legends|political]] faction that existed<ref name="JQ">''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]''</ref> by [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]'', in which the Viga alliance is mentioned, to [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].</ref> It shared its name with the [[Viga system/Legends|Viga system]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
